raw_result.task_text: I have a video call starting in 5 minutes. My desk area needs to look presentable and I should be able to see and hear clearly. The bedroom light is off.

central_instructions.R3: Turn on the bedroom light to ensure the area is well-lit for the video call.
central_instructions.R4: Organize and tidy up the desk area in the bedroom to make it presentable for the video call.

llm_judge.TF_reason: The plan fails to meet the 5-minute deadline, extending into the 5-10 minute block. Furthermore, the actions are highly abstract and do not specifically target the actual objects in the rooms to make the area presentable.
llm_judge.GF_reason: The plan contains numerous vague expressions ('any clutter', 'appropriate storage', 'arrange the items', 'check if any other items are needed'). It also hallucinates objects like 'monitor' and 'desk' (though a table could substitute, the terminology is ungrounded). Additionally, it assumes a 'small lamp' in the living room when only a FloorLamp is listed.
llm_judge.SC_reason: There are severe sequencing and logical errors. In the [0-5 min] block, R2 moves to the bedroom (r2_s1) but then arrives in the living room to receive a lamp under the same step ID (r2_s1). In the [5-10 min] block, R4 receives an object using step ID r4_s2, which was already used for picking up clutter in the first block. R2 also performs two different actions under r2_s3.
llm_judge.CQ_reason: The collaboration is entirely unnecessary and poorly executed. The bedroom already contains a DeskLamp and a FloorLamp, so asking R2 to bring a lamp from the living room is redundant. The coordination between R1, R2, and R4 involves erratic movements and conflicting locations for R2.
